text.what: A colour sport of pinot: the berry loses most of its pigment and lands somewhere between grey, pink and bronze. Same vine, same bunch, different skin.
text.story: A somatic mutation in the VvMYBA1 or VvMYBA2 genes — the switches that tell a grape to make colour. It can arise from pinot noir or from pinot blanc, and it can revert.

kin.as: The black form, and the one this site is about.
The next mutation along the same path, in either direction.
Where it grows beside its black parent under the same appellation.
